name: Hanoi to Ha Giang
summary: Ha Giang is road only. Take a sleeper bus, day bus, or limousine van, about six to seven hours. The overnight bus gets you into town ready to start the loop.

modes.note: Day and overnight buses leave Bến xe Mỹ Đình (Vietnam Tourism). Vietnam Tourism prints about six to seven hours by sleeper bus on its place page and a six-hour transfer on another page. Wikivoyage adds Gia Lâm and Giáp Bát, plus limousine and sleeper buses that collect from Old Quarter hotels, about 6–7 hours. Fares are Check on arrival.
Same road, about 300 km north of Hà Nội. Vietnam Tourism prints the same six-to-seven-hour band for a car.

seoTitle: Hanoi to Ha Giang — sleeper bus, limousine, or car
seoDescription: How to get from Hanoi to Ha Giang for the loop: day and overnight buses from My Dinh, limousine vans, and the drive.

faqs.q: Is there a train or a flight to Ha Giang?
faqs.a: No. Vietnam Tourism says the highlands can only be reached by road.
Vietnam Tourism calls Ha Giang a border province and a Frontier Area. Permit rules and fees were not confirmed on an official page. Check on arrival.

faqs.q: Can I go back to Hanoi the same way?
faqs.a: Yes, by the same road. Ask in town for the current return departure. Check on arrival.
